explanation.body: No study record is on file for this page; what it shows is its current reading, updated on its normal schedule.
explanation.summary: Pick a name and read, on one page, every reading this site has published on it, each under the name of the tool that published it and the date of its record.

family_defs.about: What the name's own price and trading history say: its score out of 100 from the scored trading day, how many of the eight checks lined up in its favor, and whether it passed every check.
family_defs.name: Price and trading history

family_defs.about: What the day's actual options trades say: how many prints there were and whether the money in them leaned to the buying side or the selling side. For the three index funds the lean is judged from the prints record; for single names the per-name tape record carries the prints and their heat, with the direction unjudged, because no record of the quote at the moment of each print exists to judge it against.
family_defs.name: Options prints

family_defs.about: What a model of the options chain says about the pressure on the price: the flip level where that pressure changes character, the walls above and below, and whether moves are likely to be softened or sharpened. A model, not an observation. Recorded for the three index funds only.
family_defs.name: Modelled options positioning

family_defs.about: What public filings and positioning records say, kept as separate lines because they are reported separately and on different dates: big holders, company insiders, and shares sold short.
family_defs.name: Filings and positioning

family_defs.about: The company's own reported facts: earnings power, financial strength, and safety checks worked out from its filings.
family_defs.name: Company facts

family_defs.about: News and events recorded against the name: announcements, reports, and other happenings that could move it.
family_defs.name: News and events

family_silent_reasons.facts: No company facts are stored for this name, so this family has nothing to read for it.
family_silent_reasons.news: No news or event record is kept for this name, so this family has nothing to read for it.

sections.about: The name's score out of 100 from the scored trading day, how many of the eight checks lined up in its favor, and whether it passed every check. For the 50 highest-scoring names, the board also shows every check one by one, dated to its own earlier session.

Separate kinds of evidence, kept separate and never merged into one verdict: price and trading history, options prints, modelled options positioning, filings and positioning, company facts, and news and events. A kind with nothing to say for this name says so, with its reason.

What the people who run the company did with their own shares, from the ownership filings gathered on the date above: open-market buys and sells kept separate, a reading out of 100, and the latest filing date.
The name's short interest reading: the share of its shares sold short and how many days of usual trading it would take to buy them back, from the settlement dated above.
Whether the name's share volume on the session dated above reached at least twice its own usual level over its previous 20 trading days, and by how much.

The headline figures the company reported for its year, each with the period it covers and the date its report was filed.
